name: Pre allocation

subjectOf.text: Under the fairness to the public definition, a fair token launch requires that the token was launched without a founding team, a foundation, or a founding dev team.
subjectOf.abstract: Under this definition, a fair token launch requires that the token was launched without a founding team, foundation, or founding dev team.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: strict fairness to the public definition of fair launch

subjectOf.text: Under the fairness to the public definition of fair launch, no early investor may hold a pre-allocation of project tokens or a pre-mining program, and any individual claim to a percentage of token supply before public sale falls outside the definition of fair launch.
subjectOf.abstract: under this definition of fair launch, no early investors would be permitted with a pre-allocation of project tokens or with a pre-mining program.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Fair Token Launch (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4015908
scope_conditions: strict fairness to the public definition of fair launch
